title: A Peek Behind the Curtain: Using Step-Around Prompt Engineering to Identify Bias and Misinformation in GenAI Models
reasoning: The paper includes a significant section titled 'Ethics of Step-Around Prompting' which evaluates the morality and ethics of bypassing AI safeguards using utilitarian and deontological (Kantian) frameworks. This goes beyond a simple 'ethical considerations' disclaimer by making ethical analysis a core part of the research methodology and discussion.
